title: observation.v1
description: Projection of a supported native or external artifact. raw.ref and raw.hash bind the source reference and bytes; raw.locator is an optional retrieval hint. Kind uses OpenInference span kinds plus eval_run, incident_record and human_correction. The codec refuses unsupported format/version pairs. The projector normalizes strings to NFC and rejects non-finite numbers before serialization. Payload remains format-specific, unverified source content.

kind.description: OpenInference's 10 span kinds + this app's 3 extensions.

payload.description: Format-specific contents; may be empty. Never validated by this contract.

source.description: Which accepted (format, format_version) pair produced this observation. format_version is intentionally not an enum -- unsupported versions are a reader-boundary fail-closed decision , not a schema-level restriction.

raw.description: First-class acceptance of the original artifact by reference + digest -- never byte preservation.

normalization.description: Declared transforms the projecting shell already applied.
